title: Security check-up
scoreBasis: {{scored}} of {{total}} points were actually measurable this run
failedBody: Raw error below. The vault has to be unlocked first.
howScored.title: How the score works
howScored.body: Every item shows points earned out of points available. They add up to the total. No hidden weighting, no curve — check it with a calculator if you like.
limits.title: What this score does not promise
limits.body: It measures how much of what this tool offers you are actually using. It does not mean nothing bad will happen. A perfect score says nothing about how strong your passphrase is or how clean your machine is.
auditAge.title: How fresh the dependency scan is
auditAge.body: Last scanned {{days}} days ago. Scanning needs a network, so it runs at packaging time and ships with the app.

detail.kdf.ok: scrypt N={{n}}, at the recommended strength.
detail.kdf.legacy: Currently N={{n}}, below the recommended {{want}}. Left over from an older vault.
detail.kdf.unknown: Cannot read the vault encryption parameters.
detail.chunks.ok: Every chunk carries its own authentication tag — changing a single byte is caught immediately.
detail.chunks.missing: No per-chunk authentication. A tampered file could decrypt to wrong content without any error.
detail.pq.ok: Post-quantum key present — protects against record-now-decrypt-later.
detail.pq.absent: No post-quantum key yet. Not required; its absence only means one less layer of long-term protection.
detail.unlock.many: {{count}} unlock methods configured — forgetting one still gets you in.
detail.unlock.single: Only 1 unlock method. Forget it and the recovery key is your only way back.
detail.attempts.few: {{count}} failed unlock attempts — looks like typos.
detail.attempts.many: {{count}} failed unlock attempts. Worth a look if that was not you.
detail.recoveryKey.ok: Recovery key is set. Forgetting the passphrase is survivable.
detail.recoveryKey.missing: No recovery key. Forget the passphrase and the vault is permanently unopenable — nobody can help, including the author.
detail.recoveryCodes.low: {{groups}} code sets, {{low}} of them running low.
detail.recoveryCodes.unused: You are not using this feature. That is fine either way.
detail.crossdevice.direct: This link was device-to-device. Nothing passed through a third party.
detail.crossdevice.relayed: This link went through a relay. Content is end-to-end encrypted before it reaches the relay; the relay sees ciphertext and file sizes only.
detail.crossdevicePath.unknown: The cross-device service is not running, so this cannot be measured.
detail.deps.clean: No known high-severity vulnerabilities in shipped dependencies.
detail.depsAge.veryStale: Scanned {{days}} days ago. Clean back then says nothing about clean today.
detail.signature.ok: This build is signed with the official key.
detail.signature.unverified: Signature does not verify. This build may not have come from the official channel.
detail.auditChain.unknown: The timeline could not be read, so this cannot be measured.
fix.auditChain: Clear the timeline under Files → Recent activity; entries after that start a fresh signature chain.
detail.auditChain.intact: The activity timeline has not been tampered with.
detail.auditChain.broken: The activity timeline does not add up — someone edited the database outside the app.
detail.update.pinned: Updates only accept the official signature; another source will not install.
fix.kdf: Changing your passphrase once upgrades it automatically (Settings → Security).
fix.pqKeypair: Generated automatically on your next unlock — nothing to do.
fix.unlockMethods: Add another one in Settings: authenticator code, email code, or fingerprint.
fix.failedAttempts: If that was not you, change your passphrase now.
fix.recoveryKey: Generate one in Settings and write it down on paper. This is the single most worthwhile thing here.
fix.recoveryCodes: Go to Recovery codes and top up the sets running low.
fix.crossdevicePath: To stay direct-only, turn relays off in cross-device settings. The cost is that transfers across different networks stop working.
fix.dependencies: Wait for the next release, or check the repository for a published fix.
fix.dependencyFreshness: The next release will carry a fresh scan.
fix.signature: Download again from the official releases page.
fix.updatePinning: Set the update source back to official in Settings.
detail.signature.unknown: Signatures are not checked in development mode.
scoreFormulaLabel: The score is the weighted sum of each check divided by the total weight, times one hundred
